title: Sale Recovery Ratio Schedule for Deficiency Balance Account Lump-Sum Settlements
content:
**Schedule.** The lump-sum sale recovery of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is the gross sale proceeds recorded on the Repossession and Collateral Recovery case that produced the account, divided by the wholesale book value of the vehicle recorded on the Retail Installment Contract that produced it. A lump-sum sale recovery of 0.65 or more adds 4.0 percentage points to the lump-sum settlement percent, one of at least 0.5 but below 0.65 adds 2.0 points, and a lower one, or one that cannot be figured because either figure is missing, adds no points.

## Schedule table

| Gross sale proceeds divided by book value | Points added |
|---|---|
| 0.65 (65 percent) or more | 4.0 |
| 0.5 (50 percent) up to but not including 0.65 | 2.0 |
| Below 0.5 | None |
| Either figure missing | None |

## Reading the records

- The proceeds figure is the gross sale price on the recovery case recorded on the account, before any recovery expenses; the net proceeds applied to the contract are not used.
- The book value is the wholesale book value of the vehicle used for loan-to-value when the liquidated contract was originated.

## Worked ratios (hypothetical; book value $20,000.00)

| Gross sale proceeds | Ratio | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| $13,000.00 | 0.65 | 4.0 |
| $12,900.00 | 0.645 | 2.0 |
| $10,000.00 | 0.50 | 2.0 |
| $9,900.00 | 0.495 | None |
